categories.summary: KerfDesk has NO dedicated print-and-cut / registration-mark workflow — no crop/registration-mark generation and no 2-point re-registration of an externally printed sheet. ADR-109 explicitly defers print-and-cut as the 'v3.5 follow-on.' The only adjacent capability is trace-from-camera (capture placed printed artwork → trace → cut at bed coordinates), which is markerless. The 5-marker system is for bed calibration, not sheet registration.
